name: sprig
description: Sprig for Claude Code: skills to make repos ready for sprig and run their workspaces, and hooks that make an agent's worktree a sprig slot. Each is its own plugin; take the ones you want.

plugins.name: sprig-onboard
plugins.description: Skill: make a repo ready for sprig, from a draft sprig.yaml to apps that start

plugins.name: sprig-workspaces
plugins.description: Skill: run sprig workspaces: check branches out in slots, start, stop, read logs, free

plugins.name: sprig-worktrees
plugins.description: Hooks: an agent's worktree becomes a sprig slot with its own ports, files and infra

plugins.name: sprig-context
plugins.description: Hook: each session starts knowing what its folder is to sprig and where its apps listen
